targets.name: Green luna moth
targets.concealment: The muted green wings merge with green leaves in the intricate floral wallpaper.

targets.name: Brown window moth
targets.concealment: The narrow folded moth follows the brown window post and repeats surrounding dried-leaf tones.

targets.name: Gold moth pendant
targets.concealment: The delicate pendant shares the tiny gold lines and brown book-spine decoration behind it.

targets.name: Moth on the specimen box
targets.concealment: The little moth is a flat gold inlay among similarly colored leaf engraving on a dark box.

targets.name: Moth in the open book
targets.concealment: The brown printed wings blend with botanical stems and faded lavender illustrations on the page.

targets.name: Skull-marked moth on the throw
targets.concealment: The gold moth is part of the same velvet foliage pattern, partly lost among leaf outlines.

targets.name: Folded leaf moth
targets.concealment: Its brown folded wings lie flush with the wooden desk among dried leaves and book edges.

targets.name: Green drawer beetle
targets.concealment: The dark green beetle is partly nested in matching brown-green dry leaves inside a drawer.

targets.name: Desk dragonfly ornament
targets.concealment: The fine bronze dragonfly lies along wood-grain lines on the sloping desk flap.

targets.name: Tassel dragonfly pendant
targets.concealment: The brass wings and narrow body merge with embroidered cord, chain and the brown desk frame.

targets.name: Small spiral shell
targets.concealment: The tan spiral shares the carved wood and gold book-edge tones in the shadowed desk corner.

targets.name: Glowing reading lamp
targets.concealment: The large glowing lamp is a deliberately easy anchor.

targets.name: Purple floral teacup
targets.concealment: The large pale teacup is clearly visible on the open desk edge.

targets.name: Round filigree box
targets.concealment: The ornate round metal box has a clear silhouette beside the lamp.

targets.name: Cream triangular moth
targets.concealment: The pale triangular moth stands out clearly against deep plum cloth.

review.notes: All fifteen targets inspected in the source and regenerated overlays. Enlarged coordinate crops corrected all moth wing extents, both luna tails, pendant hindwings, the skull-marked textile moth, complete dragonflies, beetle limbs, teacup handle hole and filigree-box finial. Affine crop metadata retained. Phone playtesting pending.
